patch.value: Live differential conformance suite against the published Node pm CLI

A test that runs the real published Node pm binary and the Rust binary over twin fixture workspaces with the same inputs and asserts resulting .toon and .jsonl bytes match, using the SDK workspace recipe clock for determinism.

The test executes both binaries; it does not read recorded fixtures only;the test is skipped with a clear message when no Node pm installation is available;create, update, comment, and close outputs are compared byte for byte

author: pi-agent

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Added tests/conformance_differential.rs. The suite locates the real published Node pm installation (PM_NODE_CLI or PATH probe), initializes one fixture workspace with it, clones the tracker for the Rust side, then runs the same five-operation sequence (create, update, comment, status update, close) against both binaries and asserts .toon and .jsonl bytes are identical after every step. The published side runs under its own workspace-recipe facility (fixed clock, zero tick) with wall-clock Date pinned, so all timestamps are deterministic. Verified live against global @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.21: identical bytes at every step. A deliberate sabotage (one changed word) made the test fail, proving it compares real output rather than skipping. Skips with an explicit notice when no Node CLI is present.

message: Live differential conformance evidence against published pm 2026.8.21
